quantity.label: Item quantity
quantity.description: How many times as many items every kill drops.

rarity.label: Item rarity
rarity.description: How many times as often dropped equipment is magic, rare or unique.

gold.label: Gold
gold.description: How many times as much gold every kill drops.

maps.label: Map drop chance
maps.description: How many times as often a kill drops a map.

kinds.label: Item kinds
kinds.description: How often each kind is chosen for a dropped item, against the others. 0 stops that kind dropping.

mapExtras.label: Cards and scarabs in maps
mapExtras.description: How many times as often a map kill rolls its base divination card and scarab drop. The map's own modifiers add to it.

items.label: Single items
items.description: How many times as likely one currency, divination card or scarab is against the others of its kind. 0 stops it dropping. Other items are ignored.
